sites.evidence_type: published tag insertion in the same loop or domain
sites.functional_impact_measured: Western blot with anti-HA antibody detected bands at ~120–130 kDa in HA-NPR2-expressing tissues but not wild-type (L4, L9); immunofluorescence confirmed plasma-membrane localisation co-incident with GFP-HRas (L13); no explicit ligand-binding or cGMP-production assay is reported in the cited quotes.
sites.rationale: All 13 ledger lines describe the same junction: the extracellular N-terminus of full-length NPR2 immediately after signal-peptide cleavage. Python computation confirms residue 22 = A (last SP residue) and residue 23 = R (first mature extracellular residue), so insert_after_residue = 22. The site is 433 residues from the TM boundary (456), well beyond the ≥3-residue minimum. No explicit residue number appears in any quote, so position_evidence is topology_derived rather than validated. Multiple independent CRISPR/Cas9 knock-in mouse lines (PMC7574965, PMC9627482) and human NPR2 cell-line constructs (PMC10702138) place a 9-aa HA tag at the extracellular N-terminus of full-length, membrane-anchored NPR2. The quotes name the site as 'extracellular N-terminus' but cite figures rather than an explicit residue number; the junction is therefore computed from the topology landmarks (SP 1–22, mature N-terminus 23), placing the tag after residue 22 (A) and before residue 23 (R). Surface expression was confirmed by anti-HA western blot (~120–130 kDa, consistent with known glycosylation) and by immunofluorescence co-localisation with the plasma-membrane marker GFP-HRas.

sources.claim: Mice CRISPR/Cas9 genome editing was used to generate two mouse lines in which a 9-amino acid HA epitope tag (YPYDVPDYA) was added to the extracellular N-termini of the endogenous LHR and NPR2 proteins; these modified proteins and mouse lines are referred to here as HA-LHR and HA-NPR2.

literature_notes: All 13 ledger lines refer to the identical site: the extracellular N-terminus of NPR2 after signal-peptide cleavage (after residue 22). No ledger line supports any internal-loop, inter-domain, or C-terminal insertion. L5 and L6 report FLAG (DYKDDDDK) and PA (GVAMPGAEDDVV) tags placed at the same N-terminal position; these failed specific detection by western blot and immunofluorescence (L6), but the failure is attributed to antibody/tag-recognition issues rather than misfolding or loss of trafficking — the protein is still expressed at the expected molecular weight. Because the failure is a detection failure at the same position (not a distinct site, and not explicitly described as function-abrogating), these are not promoted to other_positions. The HA-tagged construct is the validated surface-displayed version and is the sole site the ledger supports.
